decisions.reason: As a hearty bread loaf close to the established range and still listed in 2019, it likely meets the firm's historical aspirations and can be kept without triggering problemistic search.
The sweet pastry is close to the existing offer and showed no shortfall after launch, so it falls within acceptable performance and the firm has slack to retain it.
The crusty farmhouse bread is a low-risk extension of the core bread line and, with no evidence of underperformance relative to comparable products, the firm keeps it.
As a gold-awarded flagship product, it clearly outperforms aspirations and is central to the firm's direction, making a drop highly unlikely.
The premium stollen's gold award signals above-aspiration results, so the firm retains it as a successful seasonal specialty.
